text: A student is investigating the bending of a loaded wooden strip. Fig. 1.1 shows a rectangular strip
of width b and thickness t overhanging the edge of a bench. A length L of the strip is unsupported.
A load of mass M is positioned at point P. This causes the unsupported part of the strip to bend
with a deflection s, as shown in Fig. 1.2.
It is suggested that the relationship between s and L is
where g is the acceleration of free fall and E is the Young modulus of the wood.
Design a laboratory experiment to test the relationship between s and L.
Explain how your results could be used to determine a value for E.
You should draw a diagram, on page 3, showing the arrangement of your equipment. In your
account you should pay particular attention to:
• any safety precautions to be taken.
